title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For North Berkeley | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - North Berkeley Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
STATION ELEVATOR
Can't enter station: Take another mode of transportation such as an AC Transit bus to another BART station. The closest station is Downtown Berkeley (1.1 mile).
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to exit at another station. The closest station is Downtown Berkeley (1.1 mile).

title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For Pleasant Hill / Contra Costa Centre | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - Pleasant Hill / Contra Costa Centre Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
PLATFORM 1 ELEVATOR (ANTIOCH DIRECTION)
Can't enter station: Take the Platform 2 elevator to the opposite platform. Go back to Walnut Creek to board desired train.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to Concord and return to Pleasant Hill/Contra Costa Centre. Exit using the Platform 2 elevator.
PLATFORM 2 ELEVATOR (SFO/MILLBRAE/DALY CITY DIRECTION)
Can't enter station: Take the Platform 1 elevator to the opposite platform. Go back to Concord to board desired train.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to Walnut Creek and return to Pleasant Hill/Contra Costa Centre. Exit using the Platform 1 elevator.

title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For Powell St. | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - Powell St. Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
STREET ELEVATOR
Can't enter station: Use Union Square Market Street Station elevators at Geary and Stockton (0.2 miles/ 2 blocks) to enter station.
Can't exit station: Use Union Square Market Street Station elevators to exit station. Follow signs to Union Square/Geary exit.
PLATFORM ELEVATOR

Can't enter station: Go to the Civic Center Station street elevator on Market Street between Hyde and 7th Streets (0.5 miles / 5 blocks). Go to the island on Market at 5th to take the bus to Market at Hyde.
Can't exit station: Continue on train to exit at another station. The closest station is Montgomery St. (0.3 miles/ 3 blocks).

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - Richmond Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
PLATFORM ELEVATOR
Can't enter station: Take another mode of transportation such as an AC Transit bus to another BART station. The closest station is El Cerrito del Norte.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to exit at another station. The closest station is El Cerrito del Norte.
STREET ELEVATOR (EAST SIDE OF STATION)
Can't enter station: Use the ramp to enter the station.
Can't exit station: Use the ramp to exit the station.
STREET ELEVATOR (WEST SIDE OF STATION)

Can't enter station: Take another mode of transportation such as an AC Transit bus to another BART station. The closest station is El Cerrito del Norte. An alternative elevator is also available on the east side of the station.
Can't exit station: Take the ramp or elevator to the east side of the station, or go back to El Cerrito del Norte Station to exit BART.
